The evidence suggests a possible regulatory role for cholic acid in the function of this transporter, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The strength of the evidence is moderate, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between cholic acid and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3.
